assertion: CISA added 298 vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between January 1 and November 17, 2026, against 221 over the same stretch of 2025.
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN date_added BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-11-17' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN date_added BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-11-17' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM cyber_vuln.kev_catalog

assertion: The gap is 77 entries, or about 35%. The arithmetic checks out, since 77 divided by 221 comes to 34.8%, which rounds to 35%.
The catalog's ransomware flag covers 361 of its 1,782 entries, a 20% share that describes the whole list and not this year's additions.
warehouse_value: Now 362 Known of 1,795 (Nov 24); CISA feed count 1,805 on Nov 25; 361/1,782 = 20.3% as of Nov 18

assertion: One analysis dated November 20 to 21 reportedly counted 27 of the 298 additions in 2026 as ransomware-linked.
warehouse_value: 27 Known among the 298 additions through Nov 17
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cyber_vuln.kev_catalog WHERE date_added BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-11-17' AND known_ransomware_use='Known'

assertion: CISA then listed four more flaws on November 18 and four more on November 20 (SAP NetWeaver, Cisco Expressway, VMware vCenter, Apache Roller).
warehouse_value: Nov 18: Synology DSM, LiteLLM, Axis, REDCap; Nov 20: SAP NetWeaver, VMware vCenter, Apache Roller, Cisco Expressway
independent_value: CISA feed lists the same CVEs

assertion: Three of the four November 18 entries carried no confirmed ransomware use (Unknown); the Synology entry is tied to ransomware.
warehouse_value: Synology CVE-2024-10441 Known; LiteLLM, Axis, REDCap Unknown

assertion: The Perforce Puppet Enterprise entry was added November 17; the two-flaw notice on November 13 covered UnrealIRCd and Check Point; a six-flaw batch on November 10 spanned Cisco BroadWorks, Barracuda, Openwave Messaging, Microsoft Outlook and a Chromium component.
warehouse_value: All dates and products match; the Microsoft entry CVE-2026-124194 is catalogued as 'Office' and described as Outlook in the publisher's own Nov 10 report

assertion: Beazley Security reported ransomware incidents rose 38% in Q3 2026, and the share of cases beginning with vulnerability exploitation doubled from 14% in Q2 to 28% in Q3.
independent_value: Beazley Q3 2026 report via Reinsurance News: incidents +38% vs previous quarter; exploitation 28% vs 14%
inaccuracy: The piece says incidents 'rose 38% in the third quarter' without saying the base is Q2 (quarter over quarter), and sets it beside a year-over-year KEV figure. Primary KXAN page returned 403; checked via a syndicated copy.

assertion: The 2026 pace is faster than 2025; on the only comparison available, 2026 is running faster than 2025.
warehouse_value: Same-window additions: 2023 173, 2024 161, 2025 221, 2026 298 (2022 was 544, inflated by the catalog's launch backlog)
sql: SELECT SUBSTR(CAST(date_added AS VARCHAR),1,4), COUNT(*) FROM cyber_vuln.kev_catalog WHERE SUBSTR(CAST(date_added AS VARCHAR),6,5) <= '11-17' GROUP BY 1
inaccuracy: The piece says it is the only comparison available; the catalog holds same-window counts for 2022-2024 as well (544, 173, 161), so 2025 was a low base and 2022 was higher than 2026.

assertion: One circulating report claims CISA gave deadlines of three days or less to 78% of new entries added after June 10, 2026.
independent_value: ImmunitySec states 128 of 165 (77.6%). Pyramid Systems counts 113 of 139 (81%) three-day entries for June 11-Oct 23. The piece calls it unverified, which is overly cautious but not wrong about provenance. My own SQL recomputation failed on date arithmetic.

assertion: Synology patched CVE-2024-10441 in December 2024, and exploitation was linked to C3RB3R ransomware on NAS devices.
reason: Single-source claim the piece itself hedges. The KEV feed confirms the Synology DSM entry and Known ransomware flag but states nothing on the patch date or ransomware family; the only support found is the publisher's own sister article.
searched: Synology CVE-2024-10441 C3RB3R ransomware patch December 2024
why_no_page: CISA alert page returned 403; Synology advisory not retrieved.
